lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters following the longitudinal axis of the flank, with the highest-intensity nodes concentrated in the mid-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased luminance intersect the primary horizontal spot rows to form a coarse grid pattern, most visible in the area between the pectoral fin and the dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and high-contrast shadows on the ventral-facing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, distinct V-shaped amputation or tissue loss is present on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish/remoras) located along the ventral midline and near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
